description: Read the page's latest health check: a score (how many checks passed), and each problem with where it is on the page in plain words (like "In the navigation menu"), the element, and how to fix it. Checks cover broken links, image descriptions, leftover filler text, headings, search, accessibility and the share preview. Runs the check first if the page has none yet. On the Free plan, Search, Accessibility and Share preview problems are listed without the item-by-item detail. Not for PDFs.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

run_again.description: Run the check again now instead of reading the last result. Use it after publishing a new version. Default false.

name: get_health_check
title: Read the page health check
